title: Desktop design alignment
objective: Bring the desktop's shell (title bar, state panel, canvas chrome, histogram and status bar) into line with the Develop workspace boards, with the owner's 2026-09-26 decisions applied to both the app and the boards.
context_summary: The tools panel's module sections already match their references. The shell around them drifted: text buttons where the boards draw icons, the accent used for a selected zoom segment, undo and redo drawn as rotation arrows, identifiers in the status bar, an 8 pt panel inset where the boards use 16, a mode strip of words, photographs at Fit running under the strip, and a native macOS title bar stacked over the app's own. Masking is out of scope apart from the icon its mode-strip entry needs.

tasks.description: Align the title bar, the window frame, the state panel and the status bar with the boards.
extra_context: Title bar: on macOS the window uses a transparent, full-size-content native title bar with its title hidden, so the traffic lights sit in the app's 44 pt bar, which leaves them an 88 pt leading inset and drags the window from its empty area. Windows and Linux keep their native frames and an ordinary leading inset.
Identity: file name in 13 pt semibold, then dimensions, format and colour space as the core reports them (`3389 × 4236 · JPEG · sRGB`), then Open as a folder icon button with the Cmd+O tooltip.

Centre: one segmented control holding Fit, 100% and the current zoom percentage as a typed field; the selected segment is the neutral raised fill, never the accent. Compare and Clipping follow as icon buttons.

Trailing: Undo and Redo as curved-arrow icons, distinct from the rotation icons Transforms uses, a short vertical rule, then the two panel toggles. A selected icon button is the accent at 14% behind an accent icon, with no border.

State panel: 16 pt text inset; section labels 10.5 pt semibold tertiary in capitals; History's heading carries `rev N` at its right; this client's own entries read `you`, another client's `agent · <name>`, and Original none. The Recipe section is removed; `recipe.describe` stays in the API and keeps feeding the band dots and the crop section.

Status bar: a plain sentence of what last happened (`Applied Clarity +18 · entry 7`), with no entry, snapshot or source identifiers, and a copy icon that copies that sentence; then the pointer readout slot; then a dot and `N agent(s) connected` (green when any, tertiary with `No agents connected` otherwise), `Exact render · 16 ms` or `Approximate render · …`, and `Fit · 18% · 2×`.

acceptance_criteria: At 1440 × 900 the title bar, state panel and status bar match the default board's arrangement, sizes and colours, except where the owner's 2026-09-26 decisions differ.
No text in the status bar or the state panel shows an entry, snapshot or source identifier.
Every control keeps its message and its programmatic equivalent; no smoke scenario loses a check.

steps: Unit-test the actor wording, the status sentence, the render and clients captions and the title identity in the view models.
Capture `workspace` and `basic-panel` and compare them with the default board.
expected_results: The captured shell reads as the board does, and every scenario's checks still pass.

tasks.description: Align the canvas chrome and the histogram with the boards.
extra_context: Mode strip: icon-only 34 × 30 pt tools with tooltips naming the mode and its letter; the selected tool is the accent at 16% behind an accent icon. A canvas declaration gains an optional `icon` from the existing icon vocabulary (crop declares `crop`, the mask module `mask`); an entry without one shows its title.

Fit reserves the strip: the photograph at Fit is inset 20 pt at the top and sides and 56 pt at the bottom, so it never sits under the strip. Evidence geometry and the smoke checks follow from the same constants.
Draft bar: the mode's name in the accent, the readout, a short rule, Cancel with an `esc` hint and Apply (primary) with a return hint.
Notices: a leading icon (the spark for Changed elsewhere, the triangle for the others), a primary-text semibold title, secondary body, and the board's actions (`Discard draft`, `Reapply`).
Crop overlay: 9 pt corner squares and 22 × 5 pt bars at the edge midpoints, as the crop board draws them.

Histogram: no caption anywhere, including the plot's hover tooltip; an 88 pt plot on the canvas surface with a faint border and 6 pt radius, and the two clipping triangles inside its bottom corners rather than in a row under it. The triangles keep their tooltips with the endpoint counts.

acceptance_criteria: The mode strip, draft bar, notice, crop handles and histogram match their boards at 1440 × 900.
At Fit no photograph pixel lies under the mode strip, in either orientation.
Every smoke scenario that checks Fit placement, the histogram or the clipping overlays still passes against the new geometry.

steps: Unit-test the canvas declaration's `icon` validation and the Fit inset arithmetic.
expected_results: The chrome reads as the boards do and every check passes.
